title: Harden Codex App Server protocol compatibility
scope: Translate Temple's internal Provider-owned launch policy values into the exact installed App Server wire protocol before thread/start.
Validate Provider-owned launch requests against an explicit compatibility contract and fail closed before a live thread call when a value is unsupported.
Preserve bounded App Server rejection metadata for diagnosis without retaining raw Provider payloads, prompts, credentials, or hidden reasoning.
acceptance_criteria: Current App Server sandbox values are derived from inspected official documentation and the installed generated schema, with a documented internal-to-wire compatibility table.
Focused contract tests reject stale internal labels at the wire boundary and prove readOnly maps to read-only and workspaceWrite maps to workspace-write.
Provider launch errors retain a safe Temple reason code plus bounded RPC code classification, perform no automatic retry, and retain no raw rejection body.
Full verification and distinct Independent QA pass without any real thread/start, turn/start, model generation, Token use, external write, push, deployment, publication, or release.
overlap_resolution: WI-0029: released claim; integrated provider bridge is the base and WI-0055 owns only protocol hardening.
WI-0030: released claim; privacy behavior is retained and WI-0055 does not change command content retention.
WI-0033: unclaimed Spec work; WI-0055 does not define provider trust policy and changes only installed-protocol compatibility.
WI-0034: released claim; current-state Dashboard behavior is retained.
WI-0040: released claim; usage projection behavior is retained and no routing authority is added.
WI-0044: released claim; Dashboard information architecture is unchanged.
WI-0046: released claim; Organization view behavior is unchanged.
WI-0047: released claim; responsive shell behavior is unchanged.
WI-0048: released claim; visual style and system diagrams are unchanged.
